entities.name: T3423 value
entities.description: Information element that may be included to indicate a value for timer T3423. If not included, the UE shall use the default value.

entities.name: T3423
entities.description: Timer T3423 used in NAS procedures. Its value can be specified by the T3423 value IE or defaults to a standard value.

entities.name: T3423 value IE present
entities.description: Condition where the T3423 value information element is included in the message.

entities.name: T3423 value IE absent
entities.description: Condition where the T3423 value information element is not included in the message.

entities.name: Use default T3423 value
entities.description: UE behavior property where the default value for timer T3423 is used when the T3423 value IE is not included.

relations.description: The T3423 value IE provides the timer value for T3423 when present.
When the T3423 value IE is absent, the UE shall use the default value for timer T3423.
When the T3423 value IE is present, it indicates the value to be used for timer T3423.
